question: Which export goods had the largest declines in value between 2007 and 2008 during the financial crisis in Luxembourg?

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
2.0 % of this value is confidential at full product detail (masked codes); it is shown as a separate 'Confidential' slice, never dropped.

sql:
SELECT
  year,
  hs2 AS key,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg
FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2007-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2009-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'export'
  AND year IN (2007, 2008)
GROUP BY
  year,
  key,
  flow
ORDER BY
  year,
  value_eur DESC
LIMIT 10000
title: Largest changes by product group — exports 2007–2008

main.label: Wood and articles of wood; wood charcoal
Natural or cultured pearls, precious or semi-precious stones, precious metals, metals clad with precious metal, and articles thereof; imitation jewellery; coin
Inorganic chemicals; organic or inorganic compounds of precious metals, of rare-earth metals, of radioactive elements or of isotopes

insight: The export goods with the largest declines in value between 2007 and 2008 in Luxembourg were inorganic chemicals and compounds of precious metals, which fell by 118.6 million euros to 43.2 million euros.
The total value of exports for this category dropped by 73.3 percent.
Another notable decline was in natural or cultured pearls and precious stones, which decreased by 111.0 million euros to 84.5 million euros, a 56.8 percent reduction.
In contrast, exports of machinery and mechanical appliances increased by 609.0 million euros to 6.09 billion euros during the same period.
The data are in current euros and do not account for price changes, which limits direct comparison over time.
